keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «알이 깨지고 아기 용이 튀어나온다(문제)» 와 «벤이 새 용 친구와 함께 경주에서 이긴다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the egg cracks and a baby dragon pops out) and the ending (Ben wins the race with his new dragon friend). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Ben's egg cracks, and a baby dragon pops out. Ben thinks he will lose.
The baby dragon flies Ben to the castle, and Ben wins the race.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

qs.q: Why does Ben say, "I will lose!"?
qs.qko: 벤은 왜 «난 질 거야!» 하고 말하나요?
opts: He falls down on the road.
The castle is too far away.
evs: Every year, the kingdom has a dragon egg race.
But the baby dragon flaps its little wings.
Crack! A baby dragon pops out!
They land at the castle first.
why: 알이 «Crack!» 깨지고 아기 용이 튀어나와요. 알을 깨뜨리면 안 되는데 깨져서 질 거라고 생각해요.
The egg cracks, and a baby dragon pops out. The egg must not break, so Ben thinks he will lose.

qs.q: "But the baby dragon flaps its little wings." What does "flaps" mean?
qs.qko: «flaps its little wings» 에서 «flaps» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
opts: moves its wings up and down
evs: Every year, the kingdom has a dragon egg race.
It picks Ben up and flies over everyone!
"Oh no! I will lose!" Ben cries.
Ben wins the race with his new dragon friend!
why: 아기 용이 날개를 «flaps» 한 뒤 하늘을 날아요. 날개를 위아래로 파닥인다는 뜻이에요.
After the dragon flaps its wings, it flies. "Flaps" means moves its wings up and down.

qs.q: How does Ben win the race even with a broken egg?
qs.qko: 알이 깨졌는데도 벤은 어떻게 경주에서 이기나요?
opts: Ben finds a new egg and runs faster.
The other kids stop to help him.
The baby dragon flies him to the castle first.
evs: It picks Ben up and flies over everyone!
Every year, the kingdom has a dragon egg race.
"Oh no! I will lose!" Ben cries.
They land at the castle first.
why: 아기 용이 벤을 들어 올려 날아가고(«It picks Ben up...»), 둘이 제일 먼저 성에 도착해요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The baby dragon picks Ben up and flies, and they land at the castle first. You need both sentences.

ends: Ben and the baby dragon fly around to see the whole kingdom.
벤과 아기 용이 함께 날아서 왕국 곳곳을 구경한다.
The baby dragon goes to school with Ben.
아기 용이 벤과 함께 학교에 간다.

write.src: “I think <u>the baby dragon is a good friend</u> because <u>it helps Ben win</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: Above a dirt road full of running children holding eggs, a small purple baby dragon with big round eyes, tiny gold horns and little light-blue wings flaps hard and carries Ben, a boy with messy red hair and freckles, wearing a green tunic and brown boots, through the air toward a big stone castle, and Ben laughs with his arms wide open.

scenes.1: On a road to the castle, Ben, a boy with messy red hair and freckles, wearing a green tunic and brown boots, stops running and stares at the cracked egg in his hands, as a small purple baby dragon with big round eyes, tiny gold horns and little light-blue wings pops its head out of the shell.
scenes.2: In front of a big stone castle gate, a small purple baby dragon with big round eyes, tiny gold horns and little light-blue wings lands with Ben, a boy with messy red hair and freckles, wearing a green tunic and brown boots, and Ben hugs the dragon as the other children arrive behind them and clap.
